sql:
SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS urgent_tickets_evaluated,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bucket = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_within_8h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bucket = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_8h_24h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bucket = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_1d_3d,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bucket = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_3d_7d,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bucket = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_over_7d_or_unresolved
FROM (
  SELECT
    tk.id,
    tk.tenant_id,
    CASE
      WHEN tk.resolved_at IS NULL THEN 5
      WHEN extract(epoch FROM tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 <= 8 THEN 1
      WHEN extract(epoch FROM tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 <= 24 THEN 2
      WHEN extract(epoch FROM tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 <= 72 THEN 3
      WHEN extract(epoch FROM tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at) / 3600.0 <= 168 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS bucket
  FROM tickets tk
  JOIN sla_policies sp ON sp.id = tk.sla_policy_id
  WHERE tk.priority = 'urgent'
    AND tk.sla_policy_id IS NOT NULL
    AND tk.created_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01'
    AND tk.created_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
    AND tk.tenant_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM tenants
      WHERE name IN ('Cragsley Outfitters', 'Marrowby & Vane', 'Studio Vrij', 'Grind Collective', 'Wiesgrund Wohnen')
    )
) b
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = b.tenant_id
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY t.name ASC
note: Resolution-time buckets computed directly from tickets.resolved_at - created_at (sla_policies joined only to confirm an SLA policy exists, per the exclusion rule); unresolved-as-of-2025-12-31 tickets fall into the last bucket as specified.
